title: How to Use Sequencers in English — First, Then, Next, After That, Finally
skills: use sequencing words to organize steps and events
apply transitions such as first, then, next, after that, and finally
present procedures and processes in a logical order
improve coherence and clarity in informational and technical writing
alignment_note: Teaches common sequencing expressions used to organize steps, events, and procedures clearly. Supports coherence, transition use, process explanation, procedural writing, and technical communication across high school English courses, while also providing accessible reinforcement for multilingual learners.
